versions.changelog:
- Initial release of weibo-save: an automated workflow for saving Weibo content.
- Supports expansion of t.cn short links and extraction of full Weibo post details via browser automation.
- Downloads and saves Weibo images, bypassing private IP blocking.
- Saves content as Obsidian Markdown with organized folder structure and proper image handling.
- Optional integrations: push to Feishu Bitable, sync to Notion (including images and author avatar), and generate "Sprout" notes.
- Provides clear user feedback after each operation, summarizing save location and sync status.
